title: Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions for Embodiment Capability Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.17174v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Achieving complex, long-horizon robot behavior remains challenging because successful execution depends on skills grounded in a robot's physical affordances. Existing training-task distributions are often handcrafted or sampled from large language models (LLMs), relying on semantic plausibility rather than embodiment-specific feasibility. This mismatch can produce curricula that are too difficult, redundant, or blind to non-obvious but learnable behaviors. We propose Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions (FOSA), a framework for discovering embodiment-specific capabilities by learning a grounded task generator. FOSA parameterizes an abstract policy as a Generative Flow Network that constructs symbolic task skeletons. Each skeleton is compiled into a simulation environment, where low-level policy-learning performance provides the reward signal for the abstract policy. translated_title: 面向具身能力发现的符号抽象生成式流
translated_abstract: 实现复杂的长时程机器人行为仍然具有挑战性，因为成功的执行依赖于扎根于机器人物理可供性的技能。现有的训练任务分布通常是手工设计的，或从大语言模型（LLM）中采样，依赖于语义上的合理性而非特定具身的可行性。这种不匹配会导致训练课程过于困难、冗余，或忽视那些不明显但实际可学习的行为。我们提出了基于符号抽象的生成式流（FOSA），这是一个通过学习扎根于具身的任务生成器来发现特定具身能力的框架。FOSA将抽象策略参数化为一个生成式流网络，用于构建符号化的任务骨架。每个骨架被编译为仿真环境，其中底层策略学习的表现为抽象策略提供奖励信号。在异构机器人平台上，FOSA发现了多样且可扩展的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出FOSA框架，利用生成式流网络在符号任务骨架上学习扎根于具身的任务生成器，通过仿真中底层策略学习表现作为奖励信号，自动发现特定机器人物理可行性范围内的能力与训练课程。
en_tdlr: FOSA learns a grounded task generator via a Generative Flow Network over symbolic task skeletons, using low-level policy-learning performance in simulation as reward to automatically discover embodiment-specific robot capabilities.
